entry.title: Saint Michael's Castle

groundCutout.basis: Inspected entrance picture and retained map geometry set approximate facade, scale and orientation. Standard viewer PMTiles contain a spurious mound under this urban palace. The existing reversible ground-opening mechanism suppresses only the bounded169x170m palace/plaza patch; the model fills it with a reconstructed paved apron atY-21.15, a-21m architecture shift and a2m perimeter taper to the original PMTiles samples. CourtyardY-20.92 and normal-height foundations remain visible. Surrounding terrain is retained and restores on unload. This is approximate visual ground fit, not a surveyed urban datum.

terrainReference.basis: Standard viewer PMTiles point100m south of the model anchor, outside the reconstructed palace/plaza opening; native height preserves the retained PMTiles working datum.
